job.title: METAL MACHINIST
job.description:
Join Ronson Gears as a Metal Machinist – Where People and Passion Drive Our Success!

Ronson Gears is a world leading gear manufacturer with a reputation for precision and excellence across the Outer Space, Aerospace, Mining and Defence industries. 

We believe that great work starts with great people. We’re looking for a Metal Machinist who wants to be part of a supportive, family-oriented culture that values collaboration, quality, innovation and success.

Are you an experienced and qualified trades person with a proven track record in programming, setting and operating CNC Lathes, Mills, Cylindrical Grinding or Gear Cutting Machines?

We require the services of a self motivated and results-driven tradesperson to support our team in either of our three shifts (day, afternoon and night) in the role of a CNC Programmer / Setter / Operator.

Proven competence in CNC machine setting and operating is essential. Further experience with MasterCam and Okuma, Mori Seiki, Mazak lathes and mills, Studer cylindrical grinding machines and gear cutting and gear grinding machines would be advantageous but not essential.

We value our progressive manufacturing environment, therefore, it is important the candidate has up to date knowledge and experience in the machining of metal.
 
Why Ronson Gears?
  • Caring & Understanding: Your well-being is our priority. We care about your safety, your growth, and your work-life balance.
  • Flexibility: We work with you to find a schedule that fits your life, offering multiple shift options and the flexibility you need—whether it's taking time off when you really need it or adjusting your schedule.
  • Family-Oriented Environment: We treat our team like family. We're supportive and understand the importance of time away from work.
  • Celebrating Success: We don’t just work hard – we celebrate hard work! We acknowledge great efforts, and when we win, we win together.
  • Competitive Remuneration: We offer a competitive salary to ensure you feel valued and rewarded for your contribution.
  • Fun: Work here isn’t just about the grind – it’s fun, dynamic, and filled with people who enjoy what they do. We don't tolerate negativity.
  • Challenging & Exciting Work: Work on innovative, leading-edge technology with products that excite you. Every day brings something new and different, so you’ll never be bored.
  • Career Growth and Enhancement: As there are many varied roles within Ronson Gears the opportunity to progress your career within the company is real.
  • Training & Equipment: We provide thorough training and access to the best tools and equipment so you can do your best work.
  • Great Clients & Variety: From blue-chip clients to exciting projects, we offer a variety of work that keeps things fresh and engaging.
  • Pride in Quality: We’re committed to delivering the highest quality. Our work speaks for itself.
  • Lifelong Friendships: At Ronson Gears, some of our team members are lifelong friends. We build relationships that last.
  • Collaborative & Supportive Team: We’re close-knit and support each other. Your voice matters here – we listen and plan together as an equal opportunity employer.

Join us at Ronson Gears, where your career can grow, and your contributions truly matter. We are not just looking for employees; we’re looking for passionate, dedicated people to join our winning team.

Ready to take the next step? Apply now!
We can't wait to meet you.

If you’re ready to put your Metal Machining skills to work in an exciting and growing company, we want to hear from you! Apply today and help us shape the future of Ronson Gears.

Apply Now by clicking below or send your resume to jobs@ronsongears.com.au.

Ronson Gears is an equal opportunity employer.
Australians or Permanent Residents of Australia need only apply.
